youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for grace when Bible reading will not stick.

She: Jesus... I read the chapter. By noon it's gone. 📖
She: Every morning, highlighter, journal, the whole routine. And somehow it all evaporates before lunch.
Jesus: You remember what you need exactly when it's needed. The remembering was never your job to begin with.
She: But what if that means I'm not taking it seriously? Everyone else quotes chapters at me like trophies.
Jesus: You showed up every morning. That is what serious looks like. Seed grows under soil you never watch.
Jesus: Read again tomorrow, slower if you like. I'll handle the remembering. I've never lost a verse of you.
